statement: Trading $1k as a taker on trade[XYZ] (HL HIP-3 dex 'xyz') in the direction of a freshly visible xyz TWAP on a growth-mode market, entered 1 s after first sight and held until at most H / its scheduled completion, earns more than the 0.9 bp/side fee, spread/slippage and funding, because the TWAP's own price impact builds during execution.
prior: Unknown population. Paper (validator perps): 12-22 bp start->completion for 23 min-1 d TWAPs. Cost here ~2.5-4 bp round trip on liquid xyz books, ~8 bp by the frozen table in the 2-20M bucket where most TWAP names sit. Main kill risk: HIP-3 TWAPs are hedges by issuers/MMs with little drift. Small n.
ethics_gate: Same as H-TWAPRIDE: paper only. RIDE is a predatory-trading-type strategy (Brunnermeier & Pedersen 2005) trading ahead of a disclosed order; the owner's ethics decision and jurisdiction check (sources/leads/twap_paper_notes.md section 3.4) are required before any live use, regardless of results. Equity-linked perps add a jurisdiction question (securities-like underlyings).
universe: xyz builder-dex perps only (coin name prefix 'xyz:' or asset index in the xyz block of the recorder's meta). Main-dex, spot and other builder dexes (io, para, mkts, ...) excluded. Delisted names excluded.
qualifying_twap: de-duplicate rows with identical hash (and, for hash-less 'hist' rows, identical user+block_time_ms); keep the first-seen
first_seen_ms - block_time_ms <= 60 s ('hist'-only rows tradeable under the same rule, as in TWAPRIDE)
reduce_only == False, error is null, no trigger (twapHistory trigger_px null and no 'waitingForTrigger' status known at decision)
no terminal twapHistory status known at decision (events with poll_ms <= decision only)

growth mode at entry: the latest xyz meta snapshot with time <= decision (data/raw/web/twapxyz/meta_*, else data/raw/web/multivenue/meta_xyz.jsonl) shows growthMode == 'enabled' and not delisted. For decisions before the first snapshot (06:07-07:19 UTC 2026-10-05) the 07:19 snapshot is used; justified because at 07:32 every xyz market's lastFeeScaleChangeTime was <= 2026-10-01T00:59Z. Names not in growth mode at 07:32: xyz:GOLD, xyz:MSTR, xyz:BMNR, xyz:STRC, xyz:PURRDAT (+ 13 delisted). These are skipped (logged), not traded at 9 bp.
announced notional N = sz * xyz ctx mark (latest ctx poll with ts_ms <= first_seen_ms) >= 10,000 USD; if no xyz ctx poll within 180 s before first sight, skip (logged)
trailing 24h xyz notional V24 = ctx day_ntl_vlm at that same poll >= 2,000,000 USD (same as TWAPRIDE; the l2 snapshot shows median $1k side cost 5.0 bp, p90 37 bp below 2M)

features_point_in_time.phi: N / V24, both from the xyz ctx poll at or before first sight (trailing, point-in-time)
features_point_in_time.session: us_cash_open = decision time inside NYSE regular hours Mon-Fri 13:30-20:00 UTC (EDT; all split days 2026-10-05..10-09 are NYSE trading days); us_cash_closed = all other times. Applied to every xyz name, including non-US underlyings (CL, BRENTOIL, SILVER, FX, Korean/Japanese names) - per-asset-class results are a diagnostic only. During us_cash_closed the xyz price is formed by its own book (the oracle has no live cash reference), which is the case the session arm isolates.
features_point_in_time.rule: No feature may use any ctx, meta, bbo, event or twap row with timestamp > decision time.

decision_time: first_seen_ms + 1,000 ms (as TWAPRIDE; the lead's +300 ms is only used in the informational bbo arm, since the primary price source is 1-min)

price_source.primary: xyz ctx 'mid' from data/raw/web/twap/ctx_*.parquet (twap_recorder polls metaAndAssetCtxs dex=xyz every ~60 s while any xyz TWAP is tracked; checked 06:07-07:27: 82 xyz polls = every main-dex minute, 131 coins, mids null only for delisted/halted names). Fill reference = mid of the FIRST xyz ctx poll with ts_ms >= decision (0-60 s late). Null mid or poll gap > 180 s -> skip (logged). Exits likewise use the first xyz ctx poll >= the exit time.
price_source.why_not_bbo_primary: twapxyz_bbo_recorder started 07:40:53Z, after train began (06:07Z); using 1-min ctx mids keeps one price source across all splits, as TWAPRIDE.

entry: taker in TWAP direction (B -> long, A -> short) at the fill reference + per-side slippage + fee
exit: taker at the earliest of: (a) grid H (first xyz ctx poll >= entry + H); (b) scheduled completion (block_time_ms + minutes*60,000), exit at first poll >= completion - 60 s; (c) first poll after a twapHistory event with poll_ms > entry shows terminated/stopped/error; (d) disaster stop: 3% adverse move on ctx mid -> exit at next poll. Not a grid parameter.

costs.fee: 0.9 bp per side x deployerFeeScale (all 1.0 at 07:32) for growth-mode markets, from the latest meta snapshot at or before each fill; if growth mode is off at exit time, the exit pays 9.0 bp x deployerFeeScale (standard HIP-3 tier 0).

slippage_per_side_usd1k.evidence: l2Book snapshot 2026-10-05 07:32-07:34 UTC (03:32 ET Monday, US cash closed), growth-mode names, max of buy/sell $1k walk cost vs mid, bp: >=100M n=1 0.16; 20-100M n=8 median 0.44 p90 1.31 max 1.98; 2-20M n=28 median 0.84 p90 3.01 max 36.4; <2M n=68 median 5.0 p90 37.4 (excluded by V24 filter). Table >= p90 of each bucket and >= max of the two upper buckets.
slippage_per_side_usd1k.rule: per side slippage = max(table, recorded half-spread from data/raw/web/twapxyz/bbo_* last row for the coin with ts_us <= fill time if that row is <= 60 s old). Where the bbo recorder has no row (before 07:40:53Z, gaps), table only. If top-of-book size on the taken side < $1k, add the table value again for that side (thin top).
slippage_per_side_usd1k.cash_hours_check: The bbo recorder measures spreads during 13:30-20:00 UTC; the per-trade max() rule above absorbs wider cash-hour spreads. The table itself is frozen and not revised.

costs.funding: HIP-3 hourly funding on the position for every hour crossed, using the xyz ctx 'funding' of the last poll before the hour (sign by side).

position_sizing: $1,000 notional per trade; at most one open position per name. A qualifying TWAP on a name with an open position is skipped (overlapping same-direction TWAPs count once; opposite-direction ones are skipped too), logged. Max 20 concurrent positions.

H: completion capped at 6 h (min(completion - 60 s, entry + 6 h))
session: us_cash_closed only (decision time outside 13:30-20:00 UTC Mon-Fri)
grid.note: Grid as written in documented_edges_round8.md idea 1. 30 min and 2 h are also capped by completion (exit rule a/b: earliest).

splits.train: recording days 1-2: decision time in [2026-10-05T06:07Z, 2026-10-07T06:07Z) AND scheduled latest exit < 2026-10-07T06:07Z (straddling trades dropped, logged)
splits.validation: recording day 3: decisions in [2026-10-07T06:07Z, 2026-10-08T06:07Z); exits may run past. Requires twap_recorder restart at its 48 h stop (twap_data_notes.md); gaps reported, not filled.
splits.forward: days after day 3, frozen selected config only
splits.holdout: none separate; forward plays that role. No re-tuning after freeze.
splits.n_contingency_decided_now: Decided now on COUNTS ONLY (no outcome is needed to apply it): if at 2026-10-07T06:07Z the train count of the loosest config (phi >= 0.3%, all hours, any H) is < 50, train is extended by whole recording days (day 3, then day 4, max to day 5 inclusive) until that count is >= 50, and validation becomes the next whole recording day, extendable as in TWAPRIDE by up to 2 more days for the selected config only. If the loosest config cannot reach 50 by day 5, the verdict is INSUFFICIENT-N and no config is scored. Counting uses only qualifying-rule fields (placement rows, ctx volume/mark, meta, twapHistory status), never prices after entry.

bar_per_split: n >= 50 round trips, net USD > 0 after all costs, profit factor > 1.2, net USD without the 3 best trades > 0 (same as TWAPRIDE)
selection: Pick ONE config on train: among configs meeting the bar on train, highest train net USD (tie: higher PF). If none meets it, the highest-net train config is still run once on validation for documentation and the verdict is FAIL.
verdict: PASS only if the selected config meets the bar on train AND on validation (run once). Validation n < 50 -> INSUFFICIENT-N, extendable by whole days to day 5 for that config only (as TWAPRIDE).
kill_test_from_lead: Diagnostic computed on train only, after the first 30 qualifying trades in time order of config phi >= 0.3% / all hours / completion: if the mean signed xyz mid move fill-reference -> exit is < 4 bp, the forward test is not started regardless of the bar (reported as KILL). It cannot make a failing config pass.
diagnostics_reported: per name-day net; net excluding the single most frequent name (CBRS had 18 of 82 xyz TWAPs running at recorder start)
name-day cluster bootstrap 90% CI of mean net bp
us_cash_open vs us_cash_closed and asset class (US single stock / index-ETF / commodity / FX / non-US equity)
gross signed drift entry->exit vs the paper-implied 10^-0.78 * phi^0.303 * sigma (paper is validator perps; comparison only)

secondary arm B (informational): main-dex-style cost check, i.e. same trades at TWAPRIDE's 4.5 bp fee, to show how much of any edge is the fee
share of qualifying TWAPs later terminated vs finished; skip counts by reason (not growth mode, V24 < 2M, N < 10k, lag, open position, poll gap)
